units.en: For the Formable nations main page, see Formable nations.
List of formable nations in North America
The following are nations that are formed primarily by decision in the ⟦0⟧ file or any other decision file labeled as formable nation decisions.
The following are nations that are formed primarily by decision outside of the ⟦0⟧ file in .txt files not labeled as formable nations.
Union of Antillean Soviet Socialist Republics
The Antillean Confederation is a formable nation that can be created by ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, the ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ and the ⟦7⟧.
After selecting the decision, the following decisions will become available, coring the islands next to the Caribbean, that is considered to be part of South America.
⟦0⟧ can form this for ⟦1⟧ via decision when it goes down the ⟦2⟧ path, they unlock decisions in the focus ⟦3⟧. Letting you re-organize ⟦4⟧ into ⟦5⟧.

The ⟦0⟧ can be formed when the ⟦1⟧ goes down the fascist branch of its national focus tree, the Boston Rebellion breaks out, and the Loyalists carry out the national focus ⟦2⟧ and all of the decisions it unlocks before the Second American Civil War ends. ⟦3⟧ unlocks a set of decisions to "restore popular support for the new regime by connecting with the past", which in this case entails reforming the Confederacy from the First American Civil War, by doing things such as moving the capital to Richmond (the original Confederate capital), "enshrining states' rights", "permitting Confederate flags", "celebrating Montgomery Convention Day" and finally, rewriting the American constitution through the constitutional convention.
The nation will also appear (albeit named the ⟦0⟧) in the civil war that occurs when following the communist branch of the American national focus tree.

⟦0⟧ There is currently a bug in this: the player grants statehood to Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, while playing as either the CSA or the Loyalists, the game will glitch and revert the nation's name and flag back to using the default ones, causing the nation to become known as the "Free American Empire" if playing as the fascist CSA or the "United Kingdom of America" if playing as the non-aligned Loyalists, along with losing the unique CSA flag.

Some time after the end of the civil war, William Dudley Pelley will challenge Douglas MacArthur's government, giving the player the option to choose between keeping MacArthur in power, having William Dudley Pelley form a new government, asking Charles Lindbergh to step in, or, if ⟦0⟧ went with the ⟦1⟧ national focus and the Nazi government was overthrown, there is a 0.5% chance that the player will receive the option to install a "German-American architect" named ⟦2⟧ from Brownow, Arkansas (who looks "suspiciously familiar"), as the leader of the country.
Not to be confused with the name for the United States when they're a Dominion of the United Kingdom.

The ⟦0⟧ is a special formable nation that can be created from ⟦1⟧ by the ⟦2⟧ as a component in the formation of the ⟦3⟧ in either the Monarchist or Fascist path of the focus tree. If the United Kingdom completes the National Focus ⟦4⟧ and conquers and annexes all of the starting territory of the ⟦5⟧, they will unlock a decision named ⟦6⟧, which will, when taken, give all US cores to Canada and give Canada cores on that land instead. Canada will also change its name to the ⟦7⟧ and adopt a new flag. If the United Kingdom forms the Imperial Federation while having the Dominion of North America as a puppet, they will gain cores on the entire dominion core territory (comprising all of Canada and the United States) as opposed to just Canada's core territory. This decision is available even if the United States still exists, as long as the UK controls the continental United States and Alaska.

⟦0⟧: For this formable to work, the United Kingdom must ⟦1⟧ incite a pro-imperial civil war in Canada, as that will cause a new Canada to form that does not use Canada's country tag, preventing the decision from being taken. If you have done this, you will need to reduce the autonomy of the new Canada, annex it, and re-release it as a puppet before you can use this decision. Also, despite not being listed in the below conditions, this decision requires having completed the Unite the Anglosphere focus.
Hispaniola is a formable nation that can be created both by ⟦0⟧ and the ⟦1⟧ via completely controlling both states.
Chile may also be create it as a puppet by a monarchist ⟦0⟧ via a decision unlocked by the ⟦1⟧ focus, in which case it also gains cores on Cuba, Jamaica, Puerto Rico and the North and South Bahamas.
The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that can only be formed by a Monarchist (⟦1⟧) ⟦2⟧ under a specific set of circumstances.

To form the United Kingdom of America, the United Kingdom must force through the marriage of Edward VIII and Wallis Simpson (this cannot be the morganatic marriage), empower the King's Party, complete the National Focus ⟦0⟧, and finally conquer and own all of the starting core territory of the ⟦1⟧. This will unlock a decision to "Install an American Monarchy", which, when taken, will release the United States as a puppet of the United Kingdom, turn them Non-Aligned and install Wallis Simpson (now known as Queen Wallis I) as the ruler of the country, now named the "United Kingdom of America". In addition, the State of Maryland (which contains Washington D.C.) will be renamed to "Duchy of Wallington" and the capital city of Washington D.C. will be renamed to "Wallington".

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that represents the Federal Republic of Central America that was formed in 1823 following its independence from post-Spanish Mexico and lasted until 1841 with an attempted revival in 1896-1898. Its historical capitals were Guatemala City and San Salvador. Technically speaking, ⟦1⟧ is the legitimate successor state, being the last state to remain in the union before proclaiming itself independent in 1841.
The ⟦0⟧ can be formed by ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧.

Upon formation, the country color changes to a light shade of blue and all required states plus ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ will be cored. The following decisions will also be available coring other Central American states.
